True when the strap reports a stored exercise with a known start that the app has not saved (isStrapRecordingSaved: downloaded or predating the ledger, and held on this device by an archived session or a rescue backup near its start). A recording downloaded but stored nowhere — a failed rescue backup, or the app killed before the night was saved — counts as unrecovered, so the Recover card offers it.

branches.cond: stored exercise exists and its date is known

units.does: Asks StrapRecordingPolicy.recordingIsSaved using the download ledger (downloaded / predates ledger) and whether the recording is on this device: the archive has a session within 30 min of its start, or RawRRBackup holds a backup captured within 30 min of it (a rescue backup is dated by the recording's start).

branches.cond: archive has a session within 30 min
branches.effect: heldOnDisk true without asking the backups
